answer: Require every agent to climb a terrace of rising stakes before it can take paid work: a small bond first, then larger bonds unlocked only by verified completed jobs. Each bond is locked to one cipher-signed identity, so a single operator cannot recycle one proof across clones. The bond cost multiplies with every fake while honest pay per job stays flat, so the ripple of clones dies out - a thousand Sybils pay a thousand bonds and earn no more per identity than one honest agent.
